title: apricity-daw layout.rs: one folder per sample, a folder per kind, automatic markup only
description:
## Intent

Where each clip file goes: the browsable layout, as one pure function with tests. The file name itself comes from the shared naming function (apricitus-998976); this task only decides folders.

## Scope

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/layout.rs`: `fn sample_folder(sample: &Clip, others: &[&Clip]) -> String` (file stem; `<recording>-<stem>` for a stem from `derived_from`; prefixed by the parent folder when two exported samples share a name) and `fn kind_folder(clip: &SavedClip) -> Option<Kind>` (sections, loops, shots, and holds/phrases if included; `None` for clips that are not automatic markup: `source` not `ml`, or retired).
- Kind from the tags markup writes (`section`, `loop`, `shot`, `hold`, `phrase`), falling back to the name prefix (`sec-`, `trio`, `intro`, `loop-`, `shot-`, `hold-`, `phrase-`).
- File-name safety on folder names: only `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, anything else becomes `-`.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw layout
```
Unit tests: a stem, two samples sharing a name, a user clip, an edited ML clip (now `user`), a retired clip, a clip with tags but an unusual name.

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): browsable clip folder layout`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the specs task.
